long_biography.plain_text:
At France's finance ministry and the Élysée, Jean-Daniel Camus advised Valéry Giscard d'Estaing after graduating from Sciences Po and ENA. That senior civil-service experience supplied an unusual foundation for his subsequent work in corporate investment.

At LBO France, Camus led transactions in France and Germany before co-founding Orium. He later served five years on Intermediate Capital Group's board and as a CrossKnowledge director while the digital-learning company expanded. His CrossKnowledge tenure ran from 2005 until its Wiley acquisition in 2014. At Allary Editions, Camus supplied early capital while founder Guillaume Allary retained majority ownership and full editorial control.
